title: Pod Salt Core Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Pineapple Ice delivers the tropical taste of sweet, tangy Pineapple layered with a crisp, cool Menthol finish. The fruity notes bring a bright, juicy flavour with just the right touch of tartness, while the icy exhale keeps the experience refreshing and balanced from the first puff to the last. Blended with nicotine salts for fast-acting satisfaction and a smoother inhale, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) kits such as refillable pod systems and vape pens. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it offers clean flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and dependable all-day performance. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
